bugs.text: Console error 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading y)': when an enemy bullet hits the single player ship, losePlayerHalf assigns game.enemyBullets = [] (896) inside the enemy-bullet loop; the loop continues on the new empty array, game.enemyBullets[i] is undefined and b.y at 1242 throws. The exception escapes loop() so requestAnimationFrame is never re-queued: the game freezes for good on the first bullet death (all play-test screenshots after 5 s are identical). Nearly every game ends this way.

Tractor dive crashes on its first frame: makeDivePath returns {down, up} but the tractor branch reads enemy.divePath.p0.x, p1, p2 -> TypeError (reading 'x'), which also kills the rAF loop. About 7% of dives (boss 22% x tractor 32%) freeze the game, and the whole tractor-beam / capture / rescue / dual-fighter chain (E1-E6) can never occur.

Challenging-stage scoring never works: challenge.hits and waveHits are never incremented, so the results screen always shows 0 hits and 0 bonus, the PERFECT bonus is impossible, and hits are scored 50/80/400 by enemyPoints instead of 100 each.
No extra ship at 20,000 points or every 70,000 after; reserveShips is never incremented by score.
Zako and Goei use the same pixel shape (only the colour differs), so the butterfly is not visually distinct from the bee.
Stage badges show one flag per milestone reached instead of the arcade denomination sum (stage 7 should be 5+1+1).
Sound.enemyHit is defined but never called; ordinary enemy hits only play the destroyed sound.
Challenging-stage enemies cross in a straight line with a sine wobble rather than looping patterns.
entryDelay is computed per group but never applied; all 40 enemies start moving on frame one, so group entry waves are only loosely staggered by random entrySpeed.
A boss hit while in the 'returning' state scores 400 (diving-alone value) instead of 150.
Freed-ship flight interpolation jumps 80% of the way to the player on the first frame (unreachable anyway because of the tractor crash).

summary: The file is well organised (state object, update and render layers, fixed-timestep loop, pixel font and sprite data, synthesized Web Audio) and the presentation side is faithful: correct 224x288 scaled playfield, twinkling starfield, title score table, 40-enemy formation entered on Bezier curves with sway and breathing, curved dives with escorts, two-shot limit, READY respawn and hit-ratio results. But two uncaught TypeErrors kill the requestAnimationFrame loop outright: the first time an enemy bullet hits the ship (the enemy-bullet array is replaced mid-iteration) and the first frame of any tractor dive (the dive path object has no p0). The play-test froze within seconds of the first stage, and the entire signature mechanic (tractor beam, capture, rescue, dual fighter, captive fire) is unreachable code. Challenging-stage scoring is a stub that always reports 0 hits, extra ships are missing, and the Goei is a recoloured Zako. It looks like Galaga for the first thirty seconds, then stops.
